description: Source code implementing HTTP Range (RFC 7233) handling for the lighttpd web server, including range parsing, coalescing, and response generation.

methods.name: http_range_config_allow_http10
methods.description: Configures whether HTTP/1.0 Range requests are allowed.

methods.name: http_range_coalesce_unsorted
methods.description: Coalesces overlapping or close ranges in an unsorted list.

methods.name: http_range_parse_next
methods.description: Parses the next range from the Range header string.

methods.name: http_range_parse
methods.description: Parses the Range header into byte ranges.

methods.name: http_range_single
methods.description: Handles a single byte range response.

methods.name: http_range_multi
methods.description: Handles multiple byte ranges in response.

methods.name: http_range_not_satisfiable
methods.description: Generates a 416 Range Not Satisfiable response.

methods.name: http_range_process
methods.description: Processes the Range header and generates appropriate response.

methods.name: http_range_rfc7233
methods.description: Main entry point for handling Range requests according to RFC 7233.
